mechanism: Keep fixed ring. Compare current interleaving, drain cached tasks before scanning, and drain all known tasks before scanning. Mutually exclusive batch boundary policies, not a batch-length parameter sweep.
selection: Choose lowest bounded mean among new variants with complete/audited runs and strictly lower mean,p95<=REF in BOTH development models. Every regression retained. Only then freeze before fresh ordinary/outer validation, same gates in each fresh model. No fallback promotion after validation.
